text: Completed trench excavation in Zone B today. Work finished at 1700 hrs, all spoil removed and area cleared.
Foundation pour for the control room in Zone D is done. Concrete achieved full design depth and surface was levelled by the evening shift.
Cable laying in Section D-2 is 70% complete. 280 metres laid so far, remaining 120 metres scheduled for tomorrow morning.
Valve installation at Site C pump station 2 completed successfully. All flanges torqued and pressure test passed at 1400 hrs.
Pipe welding near tank 3 ongoing. Some sections done but not all. Team working through the afternoon.
Structural erection work was carried out today in Zone D. Progress is reasonable but we had to stop early due to wind.
HT cable pulling in the substation area — workers were on site most of the day. About half the route is done I think.
Excavation work happened in the northern section. Not sure exactly how much was done, foreman will update tomorrow.
Work done today.
Team was on site.
Some progress was made on the pipeline. Details to follow.
Trench excavation completed today, approximately 60 metres. No delays reported.
Transformer foundation and mounting work is in progress. About 40% done. Location of the unit not confirmed yet.
Finished digging the trench in Zone B. All excavation work for the pipeline corridor is complete.
Zone B pipeline trench has been fully excavated as of today. The ground has been cleared and is ready for pipe laying.
Trench digging in the Zone B corridor is done. Ground team wrapped up the excavation by mid-afternoon and moved off site.

Today we completed the concrete pouring for the tank base in Zone A. Pipe spool fabrication in Zone A is also done. Cable tray installation in Zone C substation is about 30% complete. Earthing and grounding work has not started yet.
Pipeline welding joints in Zone B are 80% complete. Pipe support installation is in progress at about 50%. Road crossing bore is still pending — waiting for contractor approval.
Cable laying in Zone B was halted this morning due to heavy rain. About 20% of the route was completed before the shutdown. Equipment has been secured on site.

Switchgear panel installation in Zone D control room is delayed. Supplier delivered the wrong panel spec — 11kV instead of 33kV. Work cannot resume until correct equipment arrives. Approximately 3-day delay expected. Additionally, scaffolding in Zone C substation collapsed overnight causing access issues for the HT cable pulling crew.
